raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: tree-sitter-language-pack
  version: "1.14.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4955f1adae50884376b9e836b3abe69a692a3c2a33ca2424c6ca1a340a613225

build:
  script:
    - mkdir parsers
    - cd packages/python
    - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ../../THIRDPARTY.yml
    - maturin build --release --interpreter ${{ PYTHON }} --out ${{ "${SRC_DIR}/dist" if unix else "%SRC_DIR%\dist" }}
    - cd ../..
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install --find-links=dist tree_sitter_language_pack
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - crossenv
        - maturin
        - python
  host:
    - maturin
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - python
    - tree_sitter >=0.23.2
    - tree-sitter-c-sharp >=0.23.1
    - tree-sitter-embedded-template >=0.23.2
    - tree-sitter-yaml >=0.7.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tree_sitter_language_pack
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          - pytest e2e/python/tests
              --deselect tests/test_smoke.py::test_smoke_avro
              --deselect tests/test_smoke.py::test_smoke_tsql
        else:
          # Filed: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/issues/176 (request honour TSLP_CACHE_DIR)
          - pytest e2e/python/tests
              --deselect tests/test_smoke.py::test_smoke_avro
              --deselect tests/test_smoke.py::test_smoke_tsql
              --deselect tests/test_download.py::test_download_cache_dir
              --deselect tests/test_download.py::test_download_clean_cache
              --ignore e2e\python\tests\test_data_extraction.py
              --ignore e2e\python\tests\test_capsule_passthrough.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - pytest-asyncio
        - pytest-timeout
        - python
    files:
      source:
        - e2e/python/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack
  summary: 'Comprehensive tree-sitter grammar compilation with polyglot bindings'
  description: |
    Comprehensive tree-sitter grammar compilation with polyglot bindings —
    Rust, Python, Node.js, Go, Java, Ruby, Elixir, PHP, C#, WASM, Dart,
    Kotlin-Android, Swift, Zig, and CLI. 371 languages.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  repository: https://github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
    - pavelzw
